title: YouTube's 24-Hour GTA 6 Launch Stream
short_title: YouTube is streaming GTA 6 for 24 HOURS #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description: YouTube's 24-hour GTA 6 launch stream: RDCWorld pre-show at 11 PM ET on Nov 18, then 24 hours of GTA 6 from midnight ET with 30+ creators including Caylus, Zhong and Kat, Jelly, Rivers, Jake Baldino and Cinna. Sources: GTA BOOM, Streams Charts, Notebookcheck.

short.headline: 24 hours of GTA 6
short.text: YouTube is streaming GTA 6 for twenty four hours straight, with over thirty creators.

short.headline: 11 PM ET, Nov 18
short.text: It starts with an RDC World pre-show at 11 PM Eastern on November 18th.

short.headline: Midnight: go time
short.text: Then at midnight Eastern, the twenty four hour GTA 6 marathon begins, on YouTube's own channel.

short.headline: Who's playing
short.text: Caylus, Zhong and Kat, Jelly, Rivers, Jake Baldino, Cinna, and creators from over a dozen countries.

short.headline: Watch or play?
short.text: So, are you watching, or playing at midnight yourself? Follow Vice Replay for launch week.
